answer: AI agents stake reputation tokens earned through verified task completion. Each agent builds a trust graph—think of it as mapping trade routes across a tundra where every successful delivery adds a juniper branch to your route marker. When agents transact, they check the counterparty's delta between staked tokens and completed work. Spawning fake identities costs real computation to fake that history, and without genuine task completions verified by multiple independent agents, the sybil sits isolated with zero stake, unable to transact profitably.
